The '''Zygerian Conference''' was an event that took place during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] [[Borun Call]] attended the conference.<ref name="Wanted by Cracken">{{JournalCite|10|Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)}}</ref>
